title: EU Data Act SaaS Switching & Zero-Egress Fee Auditor Input
description: Audit B2B/B2C SaaS platforms, PaaS/IaaS cloud services, developer APIs, and hosted AI platforms via fast zero-browser HTTP for EU Data Act (Reg. (EU) 2023/2854 Chapter VI) Jan 12, 2027 €0 switching & data egress rules (Art. 29(1)), free open export interfaces (Art. 30(2)), Art. 25(2) 30-day transition/retrieval terms, Art. 26(b) online portability registers, Art. 28/32 ICT jurisdiction & non-personal data gov-access notices, and EU DORA exit readiness.

urls.title: Target SaaS / Cloud URLs or Bare Domains
urls.description: List of SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, cloud API, or hosted AI platform URLs or bare domains to audit (supports full URLs like "https://acmecloud.example.com", bare domains like "acmecloud.io", or RequestList objects like [{"url": "https://acmecloud.io"}]).

url.title: Single SaaS / Cloud URL or Domain (Optional Shorthand)
url.description: Optional single URL/domain convenience field for REST webhooks, Clay HTTP columns, n8n workflows, or MCP calls.

datasetId.title: Upstream Apify Dataset ID (Optional Chaining)
datasetId.description: Optional Apify Dataset ID (e.g. from Product Hunt / G2 / B2B SaaS Lead Scraper or Crunchbase Finder) to auto-import SaaS URLs and deduplicate with urls.

datasetUrlField.title: Dataset URL Field Override (Optional)
datasetUrlField.description: Optional column name to extract URLs from datasetId items. When omitted, auto-detects website, url, domain, saasUrl, appUrl, companyUrl, vendorUrl, homepageUrl, shopUrl, or storeUrl.

maxLegalPagesPerDomain.title: Max Internal Legal/Pricing/Trust/Docs Subpages per Domain
maxLegalPagesPerDomain.description: Maximum number of discovered same-origin internal subpages (/data-act, /cloud-switching, /portability, /terms, /tos, /msa, /legal, /dpa, /pricing, /plans, /trust, /security, /subprocessors, /compliance, /docs/export, /api) fetched per domain in addition to the homepage (0-6).

includeRemediationPack.title: Generate EU Data Act Addendum + Art. 26(b)/28 Register + €0 Egress HTML/JS Pack
includeRemediationPack.description: Generates domain-customized EU Data Act Chapter VI Switching Addendum HTML (aligned with Commission Recommendation (EU) 2026/2394), Art. 26(b) Online Portability Register + Art. 28/32 Jurisdiction & Non-Personal Gov-Access Page HTML, and /pricing €0 Egress Widget HTML/JS when findings exist (+$0.01/site).

checkEgressFeesAndExportPaywalls.title: Check Art. 29(1) €0 Egress/Switching Cliff & Art. 30(2) Export Paywalls
checkEgressFeesAndExportPaywalls.description: Flags explicit data egress, switching, offboarding, or data-extraction fees and Enterprise-only CSV/JSON/API export paywalls lacking an EU Data Act Art. 29(1) €0 switching & Art. 30(2) free open-interface guarantee.

checkArt25SwitchingTermsAndLockIn.title: Check Art. 25(2) Switching Addendum, <30-Day Deletion & >2-Month Notice Lock-In
checkArt25SwitchingTermsAndLockIn.description: Flags immediate or <30-day post-termination data deletion (violating Art. 25(2)(g) ≥30-day retrieval), >2-month initiation notice periods (violating Art. 25(2)(d)), and missing Chapter VI Cloud Switching Addenda.

checkArt26bRegisterAndArt28Notice.title: Check Art. 26(b) Online Portability Register & Art. 28/32 Jurisdiction/Gov-Access Notices
checkArt26bRegisterAndArt28Notice.description: Checks for an Art. 26(b) provider-hosted online register of exportable data structures/formats (JSON/CSV/Parquet/OpenAPI) AND Art. 28(1)/32 website disclosures of ICT hosting jurisdiction and non-personal data governmental-access safeguards.

checkArt29TerminationAndDoraExit.title: Check Art. 29(4) Fixed-Term Termination & EU DORA Art. 30(2)(h) Exit Transparency
checkArt29TerminationAndDoraExit.description: Checks enterprise/financial-grade SaaS platforms (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / Trust Center) and fixed-term annual contracts for clear Art. 29(4) early-termination fee methodology and EU DORA (Reg. 2022/2554) documented exit-strategy support.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Checks domain /robots.txt rules before scanning and skips disallowed paths.

maxUrls.title: Max Domains Safety Cap
maxUrls.description: Hard ceiling on the total number of domains audited in a single run to prevent accidental budget overruns.

domainDelayMs.title: Per-Domain Polite Delay (ms)
domainDelayMs.description: Minimum polite delay in milliseconds between consecutive HTTP requests to the same hostname.

requestTimeoutMs.title: HTTP Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: Strict timeout per HTTP request in milliseconds (default 12000ms).
